title: Streak Metric2 Weekend vs Weekday Split
dataSources: Life score (`lifeos:score`), quests / tasks (`quest:task`), habit streaks (`streak:status`), life achievements (`achievement:life`), household leaderboard (`household:leaderboard`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The parody-the-enterprise meta layer — a Personal NOC (house-health wall), Personal SOC (entry / impossible-travel), Personal SRE (SLOs on your own habits), and a gamification layer (XP, achievements, streaks, household leaderboards) — all computed in Splunk over `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=streak:metric2
| eval dow=strftime(_time,"%u")
| eval bucket=if(dow>=6,"weekend","weekday")
| stats count as events, avg(value) as avg_value by bucket
description: Compares weekend versus weekday event counts and average value for streak metric2 (2).
value: Weekend/weekday splits expose lifestyle rhythm changes and work-life boundary shifts.
implementation: Tag streak metric2 (2) events as weekend or weekday and compare volume and `value`.
visualization: Side-by-side bar chart for weekend vs weekday.
grandmaExplanation: It times whether your streak metric2 (2) activity looks different on weekends compared with weekdays.
